question_text.description: This is the text of a question.

question_number.description: This gives the order of the question in the consultation, and also the display label.

type.description: Open questions bring responses.jsonl; closed and demographic questions bring answers.jsonl. Defaults to open when has_free_text is true, otherwise closed.

has_free_text.description: Whether respondents answered in free text. Derived from type when both are present.

closed_question_number.description: For an open question, the question_number of the closed question it was asked alongside (a hybrid question's closed part).
